hero_kpi_rationale_en: Direct customer revenue represents 88% of the company's total revenue and is the primary growth driver, reflecting the ability to monetize its base of 40.4 million direct users.

ai_positioning.summary_en: Gen Digital recognizes the growing importance of AI in cyber threats but does not position AI as a major differentiating element of its current strategy. The company mentions threat detection based on machine learning and generative AI.
evidence_en: Cybercriminals use a mix of old and new tactics and technologies, including phishing, vishing, smishing, based on machine learning and generative artificial intelligence (AI) technologies
R&D investment maintained at 8% of revenues despite AI considerations

risks.title: Dependance on R&D for innovation
risks.summary_en: R&D is critical to remain competitive in a sector where threats evolve rapidly and customer demands change constantly.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company relies heavily on research and development to maintain its competitive advantage against evolving threats. Failure to develop new solutions or improve existing ones could compromise operating results. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Intensifying competition
risks.summary_en: Increased competition can impact market share, margins, and the ability to attract customers.
risks.score_rationale_en: Competition in the technology and cybersecurity sector is intense and constantly evolving. The company must rapidly adapt its offerings to remain competitive and preserve its market share. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Evolving regulatory environment
risks.summary_en: Regulatory changes can increase compliance costs and impact financial results.
risks.score_rationale_en: Regulation in the technology and data protection sector is constantly evolving, particularly with OECD Pillar Two initiatives. The company must adapt to remain compliant. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cybersecurity threats
risks.summary_en: Data breaches or attacks could compromise customer trust and generate legal liabilities.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company itself is exposed to cybersecurity risks that could affect its customer data, reputation, and financial results. AI and machine learning-based threats increase complexity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: M&A execution and integration
risks.summary_en: Integration of acquisitions can affect operating results and expected synergies.
risks.score_rationale_en: The acquisition of Avast and MoneyLion carries risks related to integration, cost management, and realization of expected synergies. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Technology dependency
risks.summary_en: Technology failures could affect product performance and customer satisfaction.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company relies heavily on technology for its operational functioning. Technical failures, inadequacies, or errors can have severe impacts on product quality and operations. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Litigation and legal disputes
risks.summary_en: Litigation continues to generate significant costs and could affect financial results.
risks.score_rationale_en: The company experienced significant litigation (Columbia, GSA) in 2024 and a contractual dispute with an e-commerce partner in 2025 ($66M). These disputes generate significant costs and uncertainty. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: We operate in a highly competitive and dynamic environment, and if we are unable to compete effectively, we could experience a loss in market share and a reduction in revenue
